en: Colorized panoramic view of a town nestled in a wide Alpine valley, surrounded by mountains with some snow‑capped peaks in the distance. The foreground shows a dense cluster of multi‑story buildings, churches, and streets, with open fields and rail lines at the very front. At the top center, the word "Trento." is printed. The lower margin and right side contain handwritten cursive text in dark ink, suggesting it was mailed as a message postcard.
